name: Choice
overview: Scripture clearly presents choice as a solemn responsibility, emphasizing the decision between life and death, blessing and cursing. God sets before His people the call to choose life by loving Him, obeying His voice, and cleaving to Him, as seen in Deuteronomy 30:19-20. Joshua 24 further underscores this by challenging individuals to decide whom they will serve, affirming the commitment to serve the LORD alone because of His mighty acts and faithfulness. These passages highlight that making godly choices is foundational to a faithful relationship with God and the well-being of future generations.
